tasks.title: Infantry are invisible against the ground at the standard play zoom during a fight
tasks.why: The first assault across no man's land (team1 pushing from z148 to z126, tick 1322, team0 defending at z43-49) was shot at zoom 30 — the plan's own "standard play view", not the far zoom the owner already traded away (2026-10-13 decision) — and no soldier is visible to the eye in assault-standard.png despite 5-9 men reported in frame. MEASURED, TWO-VIEW: assault-standard.json contrast_median 0.03929 and assault-wide.json contrast_median 0.01241, both under CaptureRig's own 0.12 floor, both carrying its "men barely separate from the ground: unreadable" warning; crowd-standard.json (a different pose, same moment) also warns unreadable at 0.08319. A player cannot answer the owner's first question - who is winning and why - if the men fighting are not visible at the zoom the camera sits at by default.
tasks.done_when: CaptureRig.ShotCrowd at zoom 30 on a live assault reports contrast_median >= 0.12 and no 'unreadable' warning in its sidecar json
